description: Source code for API endpoints related to querying, form data retrieval, and time range processing in the Superset web application.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: Defines API endpoints for executing queries, retrieving form data, and handling time ranges within Superset.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Handles POST requests to execute a query and return payload data.

methods.name: query_form_data

methods.description: Converts human-readable or datetime string into actual time range data.

methods.name: get_query_context_factory
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the query context factory instance.
